kind: static prerequisite audit; not a runtime failure or pass
finding: The prior minimal kernel has CONFIG_PROC_SYSCTL disabled and does not provide /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id required by the new continuation gate.
fix: Enable CONFIG_PROC_SYSCTL=y, which selects SYSCTL; add PROC_SYSCTL to the existing required configuration check in build_smoke_kernel.sh. No upstream source patch.
other_dependencies: Existing procfs/sysfs/devtmpfs, GENI TTY/core/console, 8-CPU SMP, POSIX clocks, ELF/initrd and strict-translated UFS block I/O dependencies are enabled. Physical GENI RX does not depend on PTY configuration.

primary_sources.observation: PROC_SYSCTL depends on PROC_FS and selects SYSCTL.
The boot_id table and kernel/random sysctl registration are guarded by CONFIG_SYSCTL.
The existing GENI serial driver implements startup/start_rx, receive FIFO handling and set_termios.
